title: Chapter 623
paragraphs: Chapter 623
Episode 160. The 78 of Lafrarosa
The final winner of the Two Kings Tournament was neither Jin nor Baba, but Baltirok.
Kaio couldn't participate in the remaining matches due to the injuries he sustained in the 22nd match, and Jin and Baba also couldn't continue as they were recovering their arms buried in the ruins.
And for a while, Jin and his siblings became awkward.

Jin felt guilty for having pushed his siblings so hard, regardless of the reason, and the Myungwang clan was ashamed of how quickly they seemed to have 'let go' of Jin, regardless of their true intentions.

"Although we only said harsh words in anger... in truth, everyone seemed to have treated Brother Jin a bit more distantly than the other siblings. Doubting his right to succession was something that should never have happened in the first place."
"We should have acted more boldly. If we had shown the actions that Brother Gutu Wang did at the end from the beginning, we wouldn't have been so embarrassed."
"At that time, I was really furious, but everyone was too quick to suggest expelling Brother Jin."
"Brother Jin's drama was unbearable, even in words."

"I was worried what would happen if there was really someone among us who wanted to kill Brother Jin. Even if Brother Jin betrayed us, we should have shown earlier that we would never give up on him."

"In hindsight, I could have noticed sooner that Brother Jin was just acting. When Brother Shiptuwang intentionally made it look like he was severely injured, and when he attacked Brother Satuwang who had turned his back, he could have cut much deeper."
"I'm ashamed to look at Brother Jin... how ridiculous we must look."
What if Kaio had defended Jin's honor before the shocking 22nd match, instead of blaming Garmund?
What if, after the chaos of the 22nd match, Kaio had landed a punch on Jin's head with a big laugh, and the rest of the siblings casually mentioned to Jin that there was a challenge, and let it go?
What if, instead of dividing sides and fighting, and later uniting to overthrow Jin, everyone had acted like Baba from beginning to end... then they would have looked more impressive to Jin now.
Such assumptions were troubling the Myungwang clan.
Whether Jin's method was right or wrong was no longer an important issue to them.
Although they talked about killing Jin, in the end, the ultimate stance of the entire Myungwang clan was the last appearance shown by Baba.
Unlike the numerous curses spouted in anger, that alone was the only true sentiment that didn't even need to be confirmed verbally.
The proposition of never giving up on Jin, no matter how horrific the situation became, had always been absolute.
That proposition had never wavered.

If there were thousands, tens of thousands of remaining Myungwang clan members, if not half, if the situation was under the rule of another god, it might have been different. At least a few would have harbored different feelings.
But not the 77 members of the Myungwang clan currently in Lafrarosa. Their unanimity had never changed for a moment, and was expected to stay the same in the future.
"......Is your arm okay now?"
Kaio limped and sat next to Jin.
He had been loitering around Jin's room an hour ago for no reason, and had asked the same question 5 minutes ago.
"Uh......The O2 King brothers patched it up well."
Jin's answer was the same as it was 5 minutes ago.
"What about the wound from being stabbed by the Go2 King brothers?"
"It's nothing compared to what I did to the Twelve King brothers. It's almost healed. And, the Twelve King brothers can now walk a little, right?"
"Hmm. I was particularly harsh on the Twelve King brothers. I'm sorry."
The only one who had sustained injuries requiring over a year to fully recover was Kaio.
Both Jin and Baba's arms were treated immediately with Boras's special joint surgery.
"Jin, you didn't do anything wrong. I was the one who lost my mind. I think I lost it for a moment because of the revived King of Fighters tournament after a long time."
"The problem was my excessive approach. So, I should be the one to apologize."
"No, Jin, your way wasn't bad."
"In retrospect, it seems it was definitely not the best."
-'Jin! What are you trying to do? Have you forgotten all the stories I told you?
-'I did it on purpose.
-'What?
-'There was a need to stimulate the competitiveness of my brothers. Seeing the Fa2 King brothers lose to me, I thought that something like this was needed from the beginning.
The conversation with Tantel after the first conflict with Kaio.
After hearing Jin's intention to play the villain and put pressure on his brothers, Tantel had replied like this.

-'I roughly understand why. But one thing is for sure, Jin. No matter how badly you behave, the result is predetermined. No one will really hate a brother, no matter what they do. At least all of the 77 remaining brothers in Laplarosa are like that. Just like Jin.
-'I know that too. I'm curious about how that could be possible.

-'Since you're doing it, act maliciously till the end, no matter how dangerous the atmosphere becomes. Even though the fact that we were secretly jealous and envious of each other may be revealed, no one will really want to abandon a brother. Words can be said as if dealing with a sworn enemy.
Tantel's words were accurate.
However, it wasn't just because of Tantel's response that Jin acted maliciously until the end.
He also had the conviction that his brothers would never let him go, and he felt more sorry for that.
Kaio put his hand on Jin's shoulder. Seeing that rigid and large hand trembling, Jin felt sorry once again.

"That could be the case. But the same goes for other brothers. We showed each other not our best, but our worst sides. Not that I have the right to say this, but we can't always show each other our best."
Jin didn't respond, but re-fastened the bandage to make it less painful for him.

"As for me and other brothers... as you can see, we're pretty simple-minded. There are many times when we can't think of simple things. That's why we all just frowned this time. The Tu2 brothers seemed to have guessed everything from the beginning, so they stayed still. I was especially so. I didn't mean to shoot, but I threatened Jin."
"That's natural given the situation."

"No, even after the sword in my chest exploded. I didn't think carefully about the fact that my heart was still intact. Most of us thought Jin was just using the fact that he could send us out as a hostage."
"That too could have been seen as such a situation."
"But it's also true that in the process, we were discriminating a little against Jin."

"I don't think so, Twelve King brothers. It's because I stimulated the brothers. And even when I pretended to kill Baba, the brothers were ready. They were prepared to still treat me as a brother even if I killed Baba. In other words, they were willing to lose."
"Jin."
"Yes."
"Ah, wait. I can't stand anymore. Help me sit down. And stop making that distressed face. It'll all be better in a year anyway. In any case, we'll continue to lose to Jin. That fact hasn't changed."
Struggling to sit in a chair, Kaio sighed deeply.
"However, the meaning has changed a bit through this incident."
"How so?"

"It changed to the extent that we lose because you're our brother, not because you're Jin. Or, that we can't win, would be accurate. Jin is no weaker than us. And not just in terms of power, among the other brothers, there's no one who could hold on to their will while receiving such hatred like Jin."
"Does it work that way?"
"So please forgive us."
"Forgive what?"
"The fact that we have been treating Jin not as a brother, but as Jin."
"What the hell are you...."
[You're making a fool of yourself.]
Suddenly, Ban and Ring Ring entered the room. Ban flicked Ring Ring's forehead, who was sticking her tongue out.
[Ouch!]
"That's why I hit you, Ring Ring. And I don't think it's your place to say. Weren't you also unable to kill Jin?"
[Ban only hates me! Oops, hehe, hehehe.]
Ring Ring tried to be angry with Ban, but she burst into laughter when Ban stroked her neck.
"Have you arrived, Tu2 brothers?"
"There's no need to stand and bow, Twelve King brothers."
Ban's gaze fell on Jin. It had been two weeks since the Tu2 Royal Competition ended, but this was the first time Ban had spoken directly.
Outside the door, all the other Myung King tribes were waiting with their heads bowed.
"This time, you all fought like children."
"We're sorry."
"We're sorry."
"It was quite cute to see. There will be more fights in the future, fight like that. Like children. You would do that without my saying so."
Ban handed Jin the Siegmund she brought.
Jin looked at the Siegmund silently for a while.
"Jin, this sword would not have changed its owner, no matter what Jin did or how much the other brothers coveted it."
"...I understand."
"If the meaning has become heavier for everyone, then that's enough."
Jin accepted the Siegmund.
Ban didn't add any more words about the situation.
Baltirok, the final winner of the Tu2 Royal Competition, seemed regretful, but not because he coveted the sword, but because he couldn't deliver it himself.
"So, what do you think the brothers should do now?"
At Ban's words, the Myung King tribes quietly exchanged glances. They weren't sure what answer Ban was looking for.
Naturally, the tribes' glances all ended up on Jin.
"I think we need to rebuild the broken church."
At Jin's response, Ban nodded.
"The Thirteen Tu2 King brother knows well. From now on, all brothers will start rebuilding the church following Thirteen Tu2 King."
Watching the 77 brothers running towards the remains of the church without hesitation, Ban thought:
Maybe, from the moment Jin arrived, they had been escaping from a dead world.
What Ban saw now was not those trapped in a forgotten dead world, but the scenery of living people.
She also slowly followed her brothers, and all 78 of Lafrarosa gathered in one place. Along with a companion Chaos.
